Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Southwestern Contemporary Area Rug, 5 x 8 Foot, Multi
Materials: stone
Bring a Southwestern flair into your home decor with this gorgeous rug. Bold diamond shapes rendered in rich colors create a captivating design that’s sure to capture attention wherever you place the rug in your home. 5' x 8' 100% polypropylene Machine made 0.75 High
